title: docs: add D3.js analytics and visualization report
body:
This PR adds a comprehensive architectural and analytical report on visualizing Meshtastic network data using D3.js. It responds to a user request for expert advice on building an interactive web dashboard for Meshtastic network node and packet data.

Changes:
* Added `docs/D3_Analytics_Report.md` (in Polish) covering:
    * Analysis of the `node_db.py` data structure.
    * Identification of key analytical fields (e.g., SNR, routing hops, battery).
    * Suggestions for derived metrics (e.g., Network Centrality, PDR).
    * A robust D3.js visualization strategy (Network Graph, Geographic mapping, Time-series).
    * Architectural recommendations addressing the limitations of SVG versus Canvas rendering.
    * Code snippet for a D3 Force Graph using a Canvas backend for high-performance rendering of Meshtastic routing data.
